public_caveat: This is a best-available survival/rebase and queue-control package. It is not a new TeX patch, not strict all-glyph certification, not a new reader upload, not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization proof, and not a critical edition.
next_action: Use this package as a guardrail for future Noether rollups and web/source-audit handoffs; keep Batch39 as current base and avoid replaying stale P12 fixes.
